hero.title: File:Map of the Terrorism Confinement Center.png
hero.credit:
Own work using the following sources / utilizando las siguentes fuentes:

Bukele, Nayib (31 January 2023). "Centro de Confinamiento del Terrorismo". Government of El Salvador. Tecoluca, El Salvador.
Murray, Christine; Smith, Alan & Cook, Christopher (6 March 2023). "Inside El Salvador's Mega-Prison: The Jail Giving Inmates Less Space than Livestock". Financial Times. Mexico City and London.
Ventas, Leire; García, Carlos (14 July 2023). Gil, Tamara; Robino, Carolina; Olona, Carol; García Marco, Daniel; Buckley, Sarah (eds.). "El Salvador's Secretive Mega-Jail". BBC News.
 This  map was created with Inkscape .
hero.source: Map of the Terrorism Confinement Center
hero.description: A map of the layout of the Terrorism Confinement Center (CECOT) maximum security prison in Tecoluca, El Salvador (English)
